label: Stores energy
meaning: Energy resides in the selected system/state and can later participate in interactions

label: Carries energy
meaning: A propagating excitation transports energy across space or a boundary
does_not_mean: The carrier is the only possible energy form
example: EM wave; acoustic wave; gravitational wave

label: Receives / gains energy
meaning: Selected subsystem gains energy from another system

label: Transfers energy
meaning: Energy crosses a stated system boundary
example: heat conduction; radiation crossing a surface

label: Converts energy
meaning: Energy changes form or degree of freedom

label: Absorbs energy
meaning: Incoming energy is taken up by the selected system
does_not_mean: All absorbed energy remains permanently stored

label: Emits / radiates energy
meaning: Energy leaves in propagating excitations or radiation

label: Does work / drives
meaning: Energy transfer produces controlled change in another subsystem
does_not_mean: The driver must have the same frequency as the target

label: Dissipates energy
meaning: Organized energy becomes distributed into less recoverable microscopic forms

label: Thermalizes
meaning: Energy redistributes among microscopic populations toward equilibrium
does_not_mean: Energy is lost from the total accounting

label: Disperses energy
meaning: Energy spreads in space direction modes or spectrum
example: wave spreading; radiation into many directions

label: Maintains steady state
meaning: Stored energy remains approximately constant through balanced inputs/outputs

label: Exchanges energy
meaning: Energy can flow in either direction depending on state/conditions

label: Mediates / enables
meaning: System enables an energy-transfer pathway without being primary source

label: Reads out / modulates
meaning: System carries information about another variable; detector power may come from elsewhere

label: Unknown energy role
meaning: No established energy-transfer mechanism is known
does_not_mean: A new energy form has been detected

label: No create-from-nothing label
meaning: Project rule: apparent energy production must be traced to storage conversion mass-energy or external input
